about.title: About {app}
about.body:
{app} v{version}

Installs, runs and maintains games on desktop Linux and SteamOS, through Steam or standalone (umu-run + GE-Proton), with saves, runtimes and cleanup.

License: MIT License
Author: Murilo Giatti
Repository: github.com/murilogiatti/DeckInstall

Translations live in locales/*.json. English is the primary language.

mode.label: Runs with
mode.desc_steam: Steam runs the game with its own Proton, runtime and performance overlay. DeckInstall installs it, adds the Steam shortcut and downloads nothing else.
mode.desc_standalone: DeckInstall runs the game itself with umu-run and GE-Proton, from the Library, the app menu or the desktop. Steam is not needed.
mode.note_standalone_steamos: On SteamOS games always run through Steam, so Standalone mode is not offered.
mode.note_steam_missing: Steam was not found, so only Standalone mode is available.
mode.note_mangohud_steam: Not used in Steam mode: Steam (and SteamOS through gamescope) already has a built-in performance overlay.
mode.note_shortcuts_steam: In Steam mode the game opens from Steam, so no menu or desktop launcher is created.
runtimes.note_proton_steamos: SteamOS already ships Valve's Proton; nothing to download.
runtimes.note_umu_steamos: Only used by Standalone mode, which SteamOS does not offer.
runtimes.note_mangohud_steamos: SteamOS already has a performance overlay (gamescope); nothing to install.
runtimes.page_subtitle: Each component in its own card: what it is for, its status and its actions. What this system does not need is greyed out with the reason.
runtimes.nothing_to_update: Nothing to update: no runtime in use on this system.
runtimes.proton_about: Runs Windows games. Steam-mode games use the Proton chosen in Steam; Standalone games use GE-Proton.
runtimes.umu_about: Start Standalone games in Valve's runtime container, outside Steam.
runtimes.mangohud_about: Performance overlay for Standalone games (Steam has its own).
runtimes.optiscaler_about: Swaps the game's DLSS, FSR 2+ or XeSS for another upscaler. Only games that ship one can use it.
runtimes.status_not_downloaded: not downloaded (it is downloaded when first installed on a game)
runtimes.tools_about: Used for installers, archives and tweaks when present; DeckInstall never installs them without asking.
runtimes.note_standalone_only: Only for Standalone games; Steam-mode games use Steam's.
maint.runtimes_moved: Updates for DeckInstall, Proton, umu-run, MangoHud and OptiScaler are on the Runtimes tab.
add.confirm_standalone_runtime:
Standalone mode needs umu-run and GE-Proton (about 500 MB), which are not installed yet.

Download them now?
mode.note_steam_shortcut_standalone: In Standalone mode the game opens from the Library, the menu or the desktop, so it is not added to Steam.
mode.switch_confirm_steam:
Run '{name}' with Steam from now on?

DeckInstall adds the Steam shortcut (it uses the game's own prefix, so saves stay) and removes the app menu and desktop launchers. MangoHud is left out: Steam has its own performance overlay. Steam will be closed for the change.
mode.switch_confirm_standalone:
Run '{name}' standalone from now on?

DeckInstall removes the game's Steam shortcut and creates the app menu launcher (and the Desktop one, if the game had it before going to Steam). Game files, prefix and saves stay. If umu-run and GE-Proton (about 500 MB) are not installed yet, they are downloaded first. Steam will be closed for the change.
mode.switch_gaming_mode: Switch the mode in Desktop Mode: Steam has to be closed for the change.
cleanup.cat_game_prefix: Game prefix without a registered game
cleanup.cat_game_logs: Game logs without a registered game
uninstall.leftovers_intro: These paths remain after removing {name}. Select what to remove. Removing game files or a prefix also attempts a save snapshot.
library.size_hint: Size of files in the game folder. Symbolic links are skipped.
runtime.offer_proton: Apply {name} to selected games? Games set to Default already follow the newest supported GE-Proton.
runtime.offer_optiscaler: Review games with OptiScaler installed and update their copies?
runtime.uninstall_pinned: A library game uses this compatibility tool. Select another version for the game before removing it.
launch.wined3d_hint: Test this if a Direct3D 9–11 game fails using Vulkan. It switches to WineD3D with OpenGL and can reduce performance.
launch.no_esync_hint: Disables Wine's eventfd-based synchronization. Try it when diagnosing freezes or crashes related to thread synchronization.
launch.no_fsync_hint: Disables futex-based synchronization. Try it on games that hang with Fsync enabled. Proton may fall back to another synchronization method.
launch.dll_hint: Controls which DLL Wine loads. Check the game's or mod's instructions before changing the order. An incompatible override can prevent startup.
launch.raw_hint: The preview shows the generated command. In Steam, %command% stands for the original game command.
runtime.offer_optiscaler_cleanup: Review and remove the OptiScaler copies that remain in installed games?
uninstall.leftovers_changed: The path changed since review and was kept: {path}
cleanup.backup_incomplete: DeckInstall could not verify a complete backup of the selected saves. The selected paths were kept.
restore.offer_remove_imported:
The backup was imported and all files match their installed copies. Remove the source ZIP?

{path}
restore.imported_backup_kept: The backup or its restored files changed during review. The original ZIP was kept.
maint.copy_diagnostics_tip: Copies a report of this system (Steam, GPU, runtimes, libraries, tools) for a bug report. Same as deckinstall --doctor.
launch.prime_offload_mesa_hint: For machines with two AMD/Intel GPUs (e.g. Ryzen graphics + Radeon card): runs the game on the second GPU, usually the dedicated one.
launch.debug_log_hint: Writes a much longer log for troubleshooting: umu-run's messages go to the game's run log and Proton's log goes to the game's log folder (Steam games: steam-<AppID>.log in your home). Turn it off afterwards; it can slow the game down.

remove_all.title: Remove everything DeckInstall added
remove_all.intro:
This removes what DeckInstall added to this PC so you can delete the AppImage afterwards.

Your games, their prefixes and saves are NOT removed ({games} game(s) in the Library). To remove a game, use Uninstall on it first.
remove_all.part_runtimes: Downloaded runtimes ({count}: umu-run, Steam Runtime, GE-Proton, MangoHud, OptiScaler). Games in Standalone mode will not start without them.
remove_all.part_app_data: DeckInstall settings, logs, caches and the library list (DeckInstall closes afterwards)
remove_all.part_migrations: Records of old migrations (needed only to undo a migration)
remove_all.part_system_changes: Undo the system changes DeckInstall recorded (Flatpak Steam access is undone now; changes that need root are listed with their command)

add.anticheat_warning:
{name} ships {systems}.

The game itself usually runs, but online modes only work under Proton when the developer allows Linux players; some games refuse to start. Check the game on ProtonDB or areweanticheatyet.com.

Install it anyway?
library.btn_favorite_tip: Mark the game as a favorite: it gets a star and shows in the Favorites filter.
library.btn_protondb_tip: Open the game's ProtonDB page (reports from other Linux players). Needs the game's Steam AppID.
saves.restore_older_warning: Warning: the saves on disk now ({current}) are newer than this snapshot ({snap}). Restoring takes the game back to that older point. A safety snapshot of the current saves is made first.
sgdb.tip: Optional: with your free SteamGridDB API key, Steam shortcuts get artwork the Steam store does not have (games without an AppID, missing logos or heroes).
sgdb.prompt:
SteamGridDB API key (steamgriddb.com > Preferences > API).
Leave empty to stop using SteamGridDB.
hooks.title: Commands for {name}
hooks.intro: Optional shell commands DeckInstall runs from the game's launcher (Standalone mode): one before the game starts and one after it closes. They run in the game's folder with its environment; their output goes to the game's run log.
library.empty_body: Install a game from a folder or archive, or adopt games that are already on this computer.
